notes: Read all 124 line-numbered source lines before editing; every line was considered. The web component is the Drive Detail 'More Details' card: a FadeIn-wrapped GlassPanel (p-5) with an Activity-iconed title plus two grids of centered metric tiles (grid 1: Odometer, Range, Elevation Summary, Energy Consumed, Energy Recovered, Consumption; grid 2 under a border-top divider: Avg Power, Avg Outside Temp [conditional], Avg Inside Temp [conditional], Min Speed, Battery Used, Net Consumption). Native port uses RN primitives + the existing native GlassPanel / AppText / theme tokens. No DOM element, Recharts, Leaflet, lucide DOM SVG, framer-motion, or old web @/components import appears in the output.
